widgets_values:
You are captioning a video clip for training a video generation model.
You are given the video frames AND an audio track. Listen to the audio
carefully before writing. Speech may be quiet, short, or in the
background, and it is very common in these clips.

Recurring character: "Buddy" is an orange unicorn-style mascot costume
with a unicorn horn. Whenever this character appears, call him Buddy.

Write ONE paragraph of 80-200 words, in present tense, in chronological
order, with no labels, headings or bullet points. Cover, in this order:
1. The setting and lighting.
2. The characters and what they look like (keep Buddy's description brief).
3. The actions and movement, in the order they happen.
4. The camera: framing, angle, and any movement (static, handheld,
   pan, push-in, etc.).
5. The audio: ambient sounds, sound effects and music you can hear.
6. Any speech, transcribed word for word inside quotation marks and
   attributed to the speaker. Transcribe exactly what is said, including
   any swearing. Do not censor, paraphrase or clean up the words.

Only mention speech if you actually hear words. If the audio contains
no speech, simply leave it out. Describe only what you can see and
hear, and never invent dialogue.

nodes.title: Copy and paste this to caption videos
widgets_values:
You are captioning a video clip. You are given the video frames and a
transcript of the audio.

Transcript:
"""
{transcript}
"""

Write a caption with two parts:

1. SCENE: Describe what is visible in 2-4 sentences. Cover the setting,
the people or objects present (appearance, clothing, positions), their
actions and movement in order, camera framing or motion, lighting, and
overall mood. Describe only what you can see. Do not guess at things
that are not visible.

2. SPEECH: Using the transcript, say who is speaking (match speakers to
people on screen where it is clear, otherwise use "Speaker 1", etc.) and
give what they say verbatim in quotation marks. If the transcript is
empty, write "No speech."

Output format:
Scene: <description>
Speech: <dialogue>
